realms.goal: Choose which road the surviving lantern charter will serve.
realms.offer: A charter says every traveler is welcome. Last winter we counted beds instead. Jessa kept the names I stopped writing.
realms.witness: I kept those names because a missing name becomes an empty bed. Maelin wants the lanterns on the road; I want somebody to admit who was left outside.
realms.evidence: The torn charter lists both the abandoned beds and a reserve of lantern oil. Neither claim cancels the other.
realms.option_a: Keep the lantern reserve on the refuge road
realms.option_b: Publish an anonymized account of refused beds and reserve the archive room
realms.return_a: We will keep a bed ready. Jessa still asks why the list is folded shut.
realms.return_b: The anonymous exclusion count is posted, not the names of people asking for refuge. I moved a lantern indoors; the outer road still needs protection.
realms.secret_name: A lantern hidden behind the charter panel
realms.witness_return_a: I will keep checking the list. A warm bed does not make an excluded name disappear.
realms.witness_return_b: Now I can point to the refused-bed count rather than making anyone expose their name. I still have to help them find shelter.
realms.public_return_a: The refuge-road lanterns remain lit through the night, but the folded exclusion list has not been posted. There is still work for the shelter.
realms.public_return_b: An anonymized record of refused beds is displayed in the archive; the names of people seeking refuge remain withheld, and the outer road loses one lantern.
realms.mystery_question: If this road was removed from the record, why does its missing bell still direct real refugees?
realms.physical_lead: Ring the charter bells in their witnessed order, inspect contrary road records, and evade the Tollkeeper's mileglass ring before deciding who can travel.
realms.signature_mechanics: Living Roads and Witnesscraft: make contradictory routes traversable without declaring one witness a liar.
realms.thread_after_return: The absent bell's last note returns in the rain and a shared furnace. Follow either frontier story to learn what a missing thing costs the living.

realms.goal: Decide who controls the recovered pump schedule.
realms.offer: The pump schedule is ours again. Havin says the drywake families should hold it. I have watched strangers arrive with nothing but empty cups.
realms.witness: An open pump is a promise until somebody drinks it dry. Give the families a protected hour. Leave the rest of the day open.
realms.evidence: A soaked schedule shows the pumps stopped before the tanks were empty. A private water hour could preserve a reserve or become another gate.
realms.option_a: Guarantee a protected family water hour
realms.option_b: Keep access public and post every withdrawal
realms.return_a: Havin keeps the protected hour. The provisioner charges less; travelers wait until the bell.
realms.return_b: The withdrawal sheet is public. We spend more time checking it, but newcomers can ask for water.
realms.challenge: Set pump switches 1 and 3; confirm during the low-water interval
realms.secret_name: A saltglass lens beneath the dry walkway
realms.witness_return_a: My household knows when the pump is ours. I will be the one explaining the wait to the next stranger.
realms.witness_return_b: I will bring our cups at the public hour. If the withdrawal sheet is wrong, I want my name beside the correction.
realms.public_return_a: A family water hour is marked on the harbor bell. Travelers now wait through the protected interval before they can draw from the shared pump.
realms.public_return_b: Every pump withdrawal is posted where the harbor can inspect it. Newcomers can ask for water, but the public accounting takes time.
realms.mystery_question: Who profits when a vanished sea is billed as water that no family remembers receiving?
realms.physical_lead: Brace the floodgate, reverse the pressure lock under an undertow threat, and read soaked pump records from physically distinct shores.
realms.signature_mechanics: Unreliable Cartography and Witnesscraft: test whose map changes a safe crossing and who bears a false invoice.
realms.thread_after_return: The dry harbor's dated invoices echo the Reach's missing bell and the furnace's borrowed flame. A missing event can still create real debt.

realms.goal: Decide where the recovered heat should go.
realms.offer: The holding room had heat while the refuge did not. Ilyet has measured the pipes. We can warm the houses or keep a reserve for the next rescue.
realms.witness: A rescue reserve sounds humane until every cold night is called temporary. I can reroute the pipe, but I will not pretend one valve warms everyone.
realms.evidence: A service diagram separates the domestic line from a guarded emergency reservoir. Both share the same limited intake.
realms.option_b: Keep a rescue reserve with a public meter
realms.return_a: The houses are warm. Ilyet checks the reserve before agreeing to send a crew underground.
realms.return_b: The meter is where everyone can read it. The houses keep their blankets; the rescue crew keeps its heat.
realms.challenge: Touch all three cooling relays within eighteen seconds
realms.secret_name: An insulated forge grip beyond the cooling panel
realms.witness_return_a: I measured the house line this morning. It is warm. I am also measuring what remains for a rescue.
realms.witness_return_b: The rescue meter is honest. It does not make the refuge warmer, and I will not stop saying that.
realms.public_return_a: The refuge houses have warmth again; crews still measure the smaller reserve before agreeing to another underground rescue.
realms.public_return_b: The rescue meter stands in public view and the rescue heat is kept back. Some families remain cold while the emergency crew prepares.
realms.mystery_question: Why does the communal furnace breathe the missing rest of a bell that was never struck?
realms.physical_lead: Crossfeed the ash return into the shared vent, fight the provost around the heat hazard, and trace the canal to cold households.
realms.signature_mechanics: Oathbinding and Legacy Forging: test who may own an inherited promise whose heat sustains other lives.
realms.thread_after_return: A claimed ember and an absent bell both bind people to an unverified origin. Investigate where institutions charge tomorrow for yesterday.

realms.goal: Decide how the surviving debt oath will be held.
realms.offer: Velka is my name. The ledger knows me as a guarantor. Deyra found a margin where the collector wrote that I would pay for strangers I had never met.
realms.witness: The margin is real. So is the promise Velka made to two families. Destroying a forced oath must not erase the promise they still rely on.
realms.evidence: A copied oath distinguishes the voluntary family promise from the collector's added liability. The ink layers can be read separately.
realms.option_a: Keep the family promise and seal the forced margin
realms.option_b: Expose the whole oath and renegotiate it publicly
realms.return_a: The families still have a guarantor. Deyra keeps the sealed copy so the margin cannot return unnoticed.
realms.return_b: The oath is being read aloud. Some people trust us more; others will not wait for the negotiation.
realms.challenge: Enable weights 1 and 2 for a total load of five
realms.secret_name: A witness clasp in the counterweight recess
realms.witness_return_a: The forced margin is sealed separately. I kept a second copy so nobody can quietly join it to the promise again.
realms.witness_return_b: People can read the whole oath now. We still need to say which promise we will actually keep.
realms.public_return_a: The two families still have a guarantor; the added forced debt margin is sealed separately, so the old collector cannot silently claim it.
realms.public_return_b: The complete oath is read openly at the pier. Negotiations continue, and people cannot yet count on a settlement to arrive.
realms.mystery_question: Who may collect tomorrow from people whose histories were erased before any oath was made?
realms.physical_lead: Release the debtor seal, reach the counterfoil within the arena window, and read the competing tide ledgers while the duelist still threatens the pier.
realms.signature_mechanics: Tomorrow's Debt and Oathbinding: pay for temporal strength and challenge debts imposed without consent.
realms.thread_after_return: The oath ledger lists days that no calendar grants; an impossible choir overhead may be measuring the same withheld interval.

realms.goal: Choose the obligation that the restored span will carry.
realms.offer: The span can hold workers again. Kelm wants the choir anchor returned to it. The anchor steadies the bridge, but it also decides whose footsteps count.
realms.witness: I can hear every crossing in the anchor. That is why I want it restored and why Liora wants the record open. Safety has become a way to listen without asking.
realms.evidence: The anchor records footsteps as well as load. Its structural use does not require retaining a named crossing record.
realms.option_a: Restore the anchor and limit access to its record
realms.option_b: Open the crossing record and use manual load watches
realms.return_a: The anchor carries the weight. Kelm answers for the locked record; the watch still counts every load.
realms.return_b: The record is open. Liora has asked for another watcher, because reading it does not hold a bridge up.
realms.challenge: Reach the upper walkway and ground all three wind anchors
realms.secret_name: A choirweight hook on the high ledge
realms.witness_return_a: The anchor is carrying the span. Its locked record is my responsibility, not permission to listen whenever I please.
realms.witness_return_b: I have taken a manual load watch. Reading the crossing record will not hold the bridge up for me.
realms.public_return_a: The choir anchor steadies the bridge, while its records remain restricted and every load still needs a responsible watch.
realms.public_return_b: Footstep records are open to inspection and manual load watchers now cover the bridge. Knowing who crossed does not make the span safer.
realms.mystery_question: Who silenced the note that holds occupied homes aloft, and who must fall so others stay?
realms.physical_lead: Tune the high choir note, ground its opposing counterweight under attack, and cross the unstable elevated walkway to read the dissenting score.
realms.signature_mechanics: Unwrite Law and Paradox Convergence: test gravity and harmony while protecting an occupied dwelling.
realms.thread_after_return: The missing rest sustains a bridge at someone's expense; the layered quarry remembers a day the official score has no space to hold.

realms.goal: Decide what to do with an ancestor record found in the foundry.
realms.offer: Seyl's family name is under a seam the claimant called unworked. I can protect their claim by sealing the copy. Seyl wants to know who else was buried beside it.
realms.witness: Aren can keep our claim safe. I still want the other names read. I do not want to inherit a house that depends on keeping another family invisible.
realms.evidence: The seam copy carries a family claim and several neighboring names. The claimant's stamp covers both, rather than establishing either as false.
realms.option_a: Protect the family claim in a sealed local trust
realms.option_b: Publish contested lineage evidence without exposing unconsulted family names
realms.return_a: The local trust holds the copy. Seyl visits the seam because the other names have not stopped mattering.
realms.return_b: The disputed lineage patterns are on the wall, but neighboring families have not been named for them. They may bring their own claims if they choose.
realms.secret_name: A seamfinder tooth behind the stopped shutter
realms.witness_return_a: Our claim is protected. I am still asking what happened to the neighboring names under the seal.
realms.witness_return_b: I read the competing lineage patterns aloud without naming private households. Some families have answered voluntarily; others have not.
realms.public_return_a: The family's claim is preserved in a sealed trust. The neighboring names in the same stone remain unresolved rather than erased.
realms.public_return_b: The neighboring lineage evidence is displayed beside the claim without private family names; households may volunteer to dispute whose work was overlooked.
realms.mystery_question: When the stone remembers two ancestral days, who gets to unwrite the people between them?
realms.physical_lead: Brace the living seam, break its quarry tension while evading fracture hazards, and compare two physical ancestor records across the cut.
realms.signature_mechanics: Borrowed Lives and Witnesscraft: experience incompatible ancestry without treating testimony as permission to erase people.
realms.thread_after_return: The competing quarry chronologies lead to a census that treats living households as never born. Absence in a record cannot settle existence.

realms.goal: Decide how rescued people will appear in the local census.
realms.offer: Ovin can write the people we rescued into the census. That would make their beds visible to the storekeeper. It would also make their names visible to anyone asking.
realms.witness: I have a blank page and a real storehouse. An unnamed household can be starved politely. A named household can be found by someone it fears.
realms.evidence: The storehouse sheet accepts household totals without personal names. An attached index would identify each person if it were retained.
realms.option_a: Register household totals and seal personal names
realms.option_b: Publish anonymized recognition notices and invite voluntary appeals
realms.return_a: The storehouse has the totals. Ovin keeps the name page sealed and has promised to ask before opening it.
realms.return_b: The anonymous recognition notices are public, but residents' personal names remain private unless they choose to speak for themselves.
realms.challenge: Read all three lamps while unobserved; crouch or clear the patrol
realms.secret_name: An unlisted cloak pin under the census stair
realms.witness_return_a: The storekeeper has a household total. The personal page will stay sealed until somebody gives permission to open it.
realms.witness_return_b: I posted unnamed appeal notices. No census can take away the right to withhold a protected name or offer voluntary testimony.
realms.public_return_a: Storehouse staff count the rescued households without displaying personal names. The separate name page is still sealed until consent.
realms.public_return_b: An anonymized public notice recognizes unlisted households without publishing residents' names; an appeal witness can hear voluntary testimony.
realms.mystery_question: Who decides that an unregistered person is unreal when their bed and actions remain?
realms.physical_lead: Affirm the occupied bed, disrupt the empty census under a guard threat, and compare the shelter's physical evidence without exposing a resident's name.
realms.signature_mechanics: Witnesscraft and Borrowed Lives: distinguish a present person from an institution's claim of nonexistence.
realms.thread_after_return: The census refuses living people; in the orchard an unsigned law still commands them. Investigate who is permitted to author reality.

realms.quest: The Branch They Did Not Graft
realms.goal: Decide who may harvest the restored root passage.
realms.offer: The root passage is open. Alva found an old boundary cut through the graft. The old claim would keep the harvest safe for one household.
realms.witness: My household has eaten from that root for years. I will not call the claim fair just because it fed us. Sivra thinks a common harvest can survive without a keeper.
realms.evidence: A root marker names the household boundary; a later tool mark widens it across the common path. The two cuts were made in different seasons.
realms.option_a: Keep the household boundary with a public harvest share
realms.option_b: Restore the common path and appoint rotating keepers
realms.return_a: The household boundary stays. Alva leaves a share at the common post, where everyone can see whether it arrived.
realms.return_b: The path is common again. Sivra takes the first watch and cannot ask Alva to carry every hungry season alone.
realms.secret_name: A commonbark graft charm beyond the root bridge
realms.witness_return_a: I put the public share at the post myself. My household cannot call it a gift and then take it back unseen.
realms.witness_return_b: The common path is open. I have a watch hour, and so does Sivra. That is how I will know we meant it.
realms.public_return_a: The household boundary remains and a harvest share is left at the common post where everyone can check whether it arrived.
realms.public_return_b: The root passage is common again; rotating keepers now share the watch so the same gardener does not carry every lean season.
realms.mystery_question: Why does the unsigned law of a dead crown still control living roots and harvest?
realms.physical_lead: Disarm the graft, interrupt the opposite root in the boss chamber, and traverse the communal passage to inspect the unratified court record.
realms.signature_mechanics: Legacy Forging and Living Roads: make inherited rules answer to living residents and earned public access.
realms.thread_after_return: An empty throne cannot consent for the living. A threshold in Auvren asks who created the first rule that nobody remembers signing.

realms.goal: Decide how to record the reopened threshold.
realms.offer: Essel can describe the threshold we have crossed. We can seal that description for the next rescue, or let travelers read it. A description is not an answer to what began this place.
realms.witness: I will write where we put our hands and what opened. I will not write that we understand the absence. Thaelin worries people will treat a route as a promise.
realms.evidence: The threshold diagram records a working passage and two untested side doors. It explicitly leaves the origin of the first absence unknown.
realms.option_a: Keep the working route in a rescue registry
realms.option_b: Publish the route with the untested doors marked
realms.return_a: The rescue registry holds the route. Essel left the untested doors in the drawing instead of pretending they were gone.
realms.return_b: The route is public, with its uncertainty intact. Thaelin asks every traveler to read the warning before choosing.
realms.challenge: Enable boundary mirrors 2 and 3; leave mirror 1 dark
realms.secret_name: A threshold brace inside the untested alcove
realms.boss: The Keeper of the Single Door
realms.witness_return_a: The rescue registry has the working route. The untested doors are still drawn as untested.
realms.witness_return_b: The traveler can read the route and its warning together. I have written no answer about where the absence began.
realms.public_return_a: The working rescue route is recorded in a restricted registry; two untested doors remain marked as unknown, not solved.
realms.public_return_b: Travelers can read the public threshold map, including warnings for the untested side doors and a passage that still needs judgment.
realms.mystery_question: If an answer survives after its question is erased, who gains the right to name the world's beginning?
realms.physical_lead: Hold one truthful threshold, open its opposite under paradox danger, and inspect both conflicting maps before confronting the final unanswered power.
realms.signature_mechanics: Unwrite Law and Unreliable Cartography: preserve a reliable way home while allowing two contradictory accounts to remain readable.
realms.thread_after_return: The ending must test every witness and cost you carried; victory cannot prove one history universally true or revoke others' right to exist.
